removedSmallOrDowntown.rule: Removed records with known lotSqft/publicLotSqft < 6000 or ZIP 80202/direct downtown neighborhood terms. Unknown-size lots were retained.

removedCityOwned.rule: Removed records whose ownerName or publicOwnerName indicates city/municipal ownership, including City & County of Denver, Housing Authority, Board of Water Commissioners, City of, or Town of.

removedRecentSales.rule: Removed records with publicSaleYear, lastSaleDate, or lastSaleYear >= 2023. Year-only data is treated conservatively as within the last 3 years from 2026-10-01.

removedBurlingtonNorthernRR.rule: Removed records whose ownerName or publicOwnerName contains 'BURLINGTON NORTHERN RR CO PROPERTY TAX DEPARTMENT'.

removedNonResidentialZoning.rule: Removed parcels with zoning classified as industrial, commercial, open space, downtown/special commercial, campus/institutional, or non-residential mixed-use. Kept residential/residential-office/residential-mixed forms and unknown zoning.

removedNonIndividualOwners.rule: Kept only records whose ownerName/publicOwnerName appears to be an individual person or named person/family trust. Removed missing-owner records and entity/government/nonprofit/corporate owner names.

removedStrictNonIndividualOwners.rule: Second-pass strict filter: kept only clear individual/person owners. Removed trusts, corporate ownerType records, unknown owners, and organization/project/address-like owner names.

removedExtraNonIndividualOwners.rule: Removed remaining organization/project-style owner names using extra terms: ENTERPRISE, CONNECTIONS, TOWNHOUSES, TOWNHOUSE, PLAZA, PARTNERS, COMMUNITIES, COMMUNITY, SERVICES, CENTER, CENTRE

growthResidentialLayer.oldHouseRule: Denver public residential parcels: individual owner, built <= 1955, lot >= 6,000 sqft, sale_year missing or <= 2022, residential zoning, and near recent new-building permit activity.
